notes.title: Flat Trip goes free!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey, good people![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33587680/3df12435c6ad40b76b4da53421dfa08a7175ecfd.jpg[/img]

First of all, [b]I would like to thank everyone who took interest in my tiny little game[/b]. As to every artist, it means a lot to me! I've spent more than a year making it and it was, probably, the longest ongoing solo project in my entire life. I have no regrets making this project. It has its flaws, but, overall, I still think that it's not that bad for a first game :)

I was interested in games as far as I can remember, but I always looked at them only from the consumer side. Making a little project myself completely changed my perspective on them. I was very naive at first, when I thought that I'd finish it in a month or two. But, oh well :) 

I do wish to make more small and weird games (I actually have 2 of them on different stages of production), although life's not always goes the way we want, so I won't be making any announcements about future releases at this very moment.

Since the game selled poorly but I still think that it's worth checking out (if not for the game, then at least for the most awesome soundtrack written by my friend choco.bear), I've decided to make the game free. If you still would like to support me, there would be a possibility to buy a DLC with OST and a little artbook (it is free for the owners of the game at the moment).

So, yeah. That's that! [b]At 12th of December Flat Trip will be free for everyone on Steam.[/b]

[b]Have a nice day and see you in the Flat Trip![/b]

notes.title: 12th of April, the day the first human visited Space.
notes.notes:
[b]Hey folks![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587680/15019e0c7d03f6065ca5fccd63455367d6033935.gif[/img]

Today is the 12th of April. On this day, in 1961, [b]Yuri Gagarin[/b] made a trip around our beautiful planet Earth, as the first human in space. His flight aboard the "Vostok 1" took 1 hour and 48 minutes. 

Today, the 12th of April is being celebrated as [b]the World Aviation and Austronautics Day[/b]. So, I've decided to make a week long discount for [b]Flat Trip[/b], as a little tribute to the progress of science and humanity.

The discount will start at 13/04/2019 10:00 am (PST) and will continue until 20/04/2019 10:00 (PST).

Have a nice one!

[i]P.S. I've also started to make a new game, working title "Project Syz". You can watch the early progress at twitter.com/shushpo [/i]

notes.title: Flat Trip: A message to you.
notes.notes:
[b]Hi![/b] 
If you see this, this might mean that you have [b]Flat Trip[/b] in your game library.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587680/67861e4474809b22761a8dc06877a87d1d873565.gif[/img]

Or, you're just passing by this community center, dedicated to the game [b]Flat Trip[/b] (if that's the case - Welcome!).

My name is Dmitry (aka shushpo) and I'm the graphic artist and the developer of this little game.

This game is my first serious game project, published on Steam. I've spent approximately a year making this game. You can even say that this is my biggest (or more like the longest in production) project yet.

I'm really glad to see, that there are people that found [b]Flat Trip[/b] interesting. As for almost every artist, it's really awesome, when your creations find their viewers.

I was going to write a big rant about how hard it is for a small indie game that was made with love (not an asset-flip or achievement abuse stuff) to get to the surface of Steam store, but I think that most of Steam users already know this.

So I'm just gonna ask one little thing. If you liked [b]Flat Trip[/b] and you got a free minute - [b]please, leave a review[/b] on its Steam store page. It should (at least I hope so) help [b]Flat Trip[/b] to get closer to its potential users (and collect some money to pay the taxes in the end of this year, I'm not even hoping to get something extra at this point).

Big thanks if you're already an owner of [b]Flat Trip[/b] game and an even bigger thanks for leaving a review!

[b]Cheers and see you in the Flat Trip![/b]

Dmitry

notes.title: Flat Trip: Community Avatars
notes.notes: Hey guys and gals! How's it going? I've added official Flat Trip community avatars. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587680/d68ca6aa53c271d12df95c4811179e380fd7d9a6.png[/img] You can use them by going in your profile settings -> find avatar section -> select from official game avatars -> choose any of the desired avatars. Just thought that it would be nice to have that :) Feel free to use them if you want. Cheers!
